proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D hABC hD hr
  have hAC : dist A C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr (ne₁₃_of_not_collinear hABC)
  have hAB : dist A B ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr (ne₁₂_of_not_collinear hABC)
  have hBC : dist B C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hD.left_ne_right
  have hDC : dist D C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hD.ne_right
  have cross := (div_eq_div_iff hAC hDC).mp hr
  have hAD : A ≠ D := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hABC (collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair hD.wbtw.mem_affineSpan)
  obtain ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, -, -⟩ := hD
  rw [dist_left_lineMap, dist_lineMap_right, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.1, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2])] at cross
  have key : dist A B * (1 - t) = t * dist A C := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hBC
    linear_combination cross
  have hv : (AffineMap.lineMap B C t : P) -ᵥ A = (1 - t) • (B -ᵥ A) + t • (C -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A]
    module
  have hvn : ‖(AffineMap.lineMap B C t : P) -ᵥ A‖ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [norm_ne_zero_iff]; exact vsub_ne_zero.mpr hAD.symm
  have hc : ‖B -ᵥ A‖ = dist A B := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V]
  have hb : ‖C -ᵥ A‖ = dist A C := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V]
  unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle InnerProductGeometry.angle
  congr 1
  rw [hc, hb, div_eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero hAB hvn) (mul_ne_zero hvn hAC), hv, inner_add_right, inner_add_left,
    real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hc, hb]
  linear_combination ‖(1 - t) • (B -ᵥ A) + t • (C -ᵥ A)‖ * (dist A B * dist A C - inner ℝ (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A)) * key
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → Sbtw ℝ B D C → dist A B / dist A C = dist B D / dist D C → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A D = EuclideanGeometry.angle D A C
